method: Editorial review of setting continuity, separate from overall. Complements the Italian service/block proxy; explicit user choices take precedence.

sir-susa-scai-perugia-02.basis: Season-long continuity explicitly described in the captain's season review; service/block variability alone is not setting consistency.

rana-verona-10.basis: Club's full-season review describes precise, consistent distribution across 34 matches / 121 sets. Current injury is not treated as a permanent consistency class.

vero-volley-monza-07.basis: Repeated setting performance over four collegiate seasons, 31 appearances in 2026 and sustained team attack efficiency. Editorial estimate; college-to-SuperLega adaptation remains uncertain.

cucine-lube-civitanova-01.basis: International setting output across the World Championship and VNL supplements missing Italian match history. Shorter senior history warrants B rather than an automatic A based on talent.
